pages.en:
Police
Sp. Br. Registry.
No. U. 391
Date 21-10-46
09-30-46

Foreign Affairs

Re attached report "Activities of A.A.Baiko"

With reference to the attached report the following information has been obtained by enquiries:

In the report there is a mistake in spelling of the person who has been made subject of the report, the correct name is BAIKO Alexandr Alexandrovich, born 1887 in Odessa, Russia, Ukrainian. Residing at 135 Rte. Grouchy tel. 71484. Wife: Sophia (b.1905), son: George (b.1930). Arrived at Shanghai from Tsingtao on 1-8-1946. Formerly he was a colonel in the troops of Ataman Semenoff and together with At. Semenoff evacuated from Russia to China. On arrival from Tsingtao he opened together with his brother SOKOL-SKY-BAIKO Pavel Alexandrovich (who has made allegations mentioned in the attached report) musical publishing company, but later both brothers had some disagreement between themselves which developed into bitter quarrel over their property (they both also own a house at 135 Rte. Grouchy) and the case was heard in Court.

Enquiries re political tendencies of A.A.Baiko failed to discover anything incriminating and it is thought that his brother P.A.Sokolsky (in the attached report a mistake was made in spelling - Lokolsky;) because of the grudge between brothers could have made an above report alleging A.A.Baiko to be involved in political activities.

Observation will be kept on activities of A.A.Baiko and an additional report will be forwarded if any information of interest will be obtained.

B. Vankoff
pages.zh:
警务处
特别支部登记室。
编号 U. 391
日期 1946年10月21日
1946年9月30日

外事

关于所附报告“亚历山大·亚历山德罗维奇·拜科（A.A.Baiko）的活动”

就所附报告而言，经查询获得如下信息：

报告中被调查对象的姓名拼写有误，正确姓名为 BAIKO Alexandr Alexandrovich（亚历山大·亚历山德罗维奇·拜科），1887年生于俄罗斯敖德萨，乌克兰人。现居住于格罗希路（Rte. Grouchy）135号，电话 71484。妻子：索菲亚（Sophia，生于1905年）；儿子：乔治（George，生于1930年）。他于1946年8月1日从青岛抵达上海。此前，他曾担任阿塔曼·谢苗诺夫（Ataman Semenoff）部队的上校，并随谢苗诺夫阿塔曼从俄罗斯撤离至中国。从青岛抵达后，他与兄弟帕维尔·亚历山德罗维奇·索科尔斯基-拜科（SOKOL-SKY-BAIKO Pavel Alexandrovich）（即所附报告中提出指控之人）共同开办了一家音乐出版公司，但后来兄弟二人发生分歧，进而因财产问题（二人共同拥有格罗希路135号的一处房产）爆发激烈争吵，该案已诉诸法庭审理。

关于 A.A.拜科政治倾向的调查未发现任何罪证，据信其兄弟 P.A.索科尔斯基（所附报告中拼写有误，误作 Lokolsky）可能出于兄弟间的积怨，提交了上述报告，诬称 A.A.拜科参与政治活动。

将对 A.A.拜科的活动保持监视，如获取任何值得关注的信息，将另行呈报。

B. Vankoff
